planSteps.description: Navigate to /Account/Login and sign in as bilal.khan@example.com with the password Nexus@2026
Navigate to /Profile and click the Edit profile button
Assert the profile edit form is displayed at /Profile/Edit with Full Name and Contact Number fields
Change the Contact Number field to 03009998877 and click Save Changes
Assert the browser returns to the profile page and a confirmation message is shown
Assert the contact number shown is 03009998877. If the old number is still displayed, this test must fail.
Navigate back to /Profile/Edit and submit the form with the Full Name field emptied
Assert a validation message is shown against the Full Name field and the change is not saved
